reported_regression: Mod Workspace's global What does this do? panel was below the effective window cavity and appeared empty/off-screen.
root_cause: WIP193/WIP194 packed the expanding Notebook before the old bottom help/log panes, allowing the Notebook to consume the remaining pack cavity. An initial WIP195 bottom-reservation fix made the help visible but stole too much height from Game Rip's protected console.

final_fix.context_help: compact always-visible What does this do? strip above the Notebook
final_fix.context_help_widget: wrapped ttk.Label backed by StringVar; no blank Text viewport
final_fix.task_log: separate 900x380 on-demand Toplevel opened by Task log…; hidden by default, output retained
final_fix.tab_height_policy: task log consumes zero Notebook height while hidden or open
final_fix.focus_help: FocusOut/Leave restore the selected tab's default explanation

requirements: Mod Workspace contextual help is visible and populated at normal desktop geometries
Task log remains available without permanently consuming tab height
Game Rip dedicated console remains readable after the help correction
No tab needs to rely on an off-screen global footer
